page.title: CuePic - Send “tap here” as an image
page.description: CuePic helps you add red circles, rectangles, pointers, and arrows to images so you can show where to tap, where to look, or what steps to follow.
hero.title: CuePic
hero.lead: Before writing a long explanation, show them “right here.” Add a red circle or rectangle to an image and share a clear visual cue that is easy to understand.
hero.note: This page is provided as the official marketing page for CuePic. App availability may vary by region and review status.
features.title: Show “right here” without a long explanation
features.lead: CuePic is made for moments when words alone are not enough. Mark the place to tap, the place to look, or the order to follow, then share the image right away.
features.card.mark.title: Mark the important spot
features.card.mark.body: Add a red circle or rectangle to make the important part of an image stand out clearly.
features.card.pro.title: Make it even clearer with Pro
features.card.pro.body: Use pointers, arrows, and multi-image step guides when one marked image is not enough.
features.card.share.title: Share right away
features.card.share.body: Create an image that says “tap here” or “look here,” then send it to family, friends, or people at work.
features.card.reduce.title: Reduce small misunderstandings
features.card.reduce.body: Replace long explanations like “the button in the top right” with a simple visual mark.
about.title: Built for phone help, quick checks, and small guides
about.lead: CuePic is a small image explanation app for helping someone understand a specific place or step. It is useful when you want to explain a phone screen, point out a part of an image, or turn several screens into a simple guide.
about.useful.title: Useful when
about.useful.item.tap: You want to show someone where to tap on their phone
about.useful.item.look: You want to point out where to look in an image
about.useful.item.words: Words alone are hard to explain
about.useful.item.steps: You want to show multiple screens as steps
about.simple.title: Simple by design
about.simple.item.start: Start with one image and a clear mark
about.simple.item.pro: Use pointers, arrows, and step guides with CuePic Pro
about.simple.item.account: No account is required for the core local workflow
about.simple.item.support: Support and privacy information are available from this page
about.note.title: A small note before you use it.
about.note.body: CuePic helps you create clearer explanation images. Please make sure you have the right to use and share the images you choose.
cta.title: When explaining gets easier, the conversation can feel kinder.
cta.body: Add a simple “right here” to an image and share it with someone who needs a clearer cue.
